title: Find us
directions: We are five minutes' walk from the centre of Portree and from the bus station in Somerled Square. Portree is about forty-five minutes from the Skye Bridge and two and a half hours from Inverness. Parking is available on request, so let us know when you book and we will keep a space for you.
arrival: If you need to arrive earlier or later than that, please call or message us before you travel so we can arrange it; late arrivals can collect keys from the lockbox beside the front door.
